zh-Hant.text: 天將降大任於斯人也，必先苦其心志，勞其筋骨，餓其體膚，空乏其身，行拂亂其所為，所以動心忍性，曾益其所不能。
不積跬步，無以至千里；不積小流，無以成江海。
路漫漫其修遠兮，吾將上下而求索。
寶劍鋒從磨礪出，梅花香自苦寒來。
山重水複疑無路，柳暗花明又一村。
世上無難事，只怕有心人。
千里之行，始於足下。
失敗乃成功之母。
有志者，事竟成。
吃得苦中苦，方為人上人。
今日的努力，是明日成功的基石。
每一次跌倒，都是為了更堅強地站起來。
機會總是留給有準備的人。
堅持就是勝利。
相信自己，你比想像中更強大。
困難像彈簧，你弱它就強，你強它就弱。
不要害怕慢，只要不停下腳步。
成功不是終點，失敗也不是末日，繼續前進的勇氣才是最重要的。
今天的你，是昨天努力的結果；明天的你，是今天努力的結果。
與其擔心未來，不如現在好好努力。
人生沒有白走的路，每一步都算數。
只有經歷過地獄般的磨練，才能煉出創造天堂的力量。
不要讓昨天的失敗，影響今天的努力。
成功的人找方法，失敗的人找藉口。
你的潛力遠超你的想像，加油！
每一次挑戰，都是成長的機會。
不要等待機會，而要創造機會。
努力不一定成功，但不努力一定不會成功。
風雨過後，總會有彩虹。
做最好的自己，比什麼都重要。
時間不會辜負每一個努力的人。
當你覺得累的時候，說明你正在走上坡路。
沒有過不去的坎，只有過不去的心。
夢想不會發光，發光的是追夢的你。
今天的汗水，是明天的收穫。
不要因為一次失敗，就放棄你原來決心達到的目標。
行動是治癒恐懼的良藥，而猶豫、拖延將不斷滋養恐懼。
你今天的努力，決定你明天的位置。
生活不會因為你抱怨而改變，但會因為你的努力而改變。
相信自己，沒有什麼不可能。
成功不是將來才有的，而是從決定去做的那一刻起，持續累積而成。
不要讓別人的看法，阻擋你前進的腳步。
每一個不曾起舞的日子，都是對生命的辜負。
困難是暫時的，放棄是永久的。
你的堅持，終將美好。
不要害怕慢，只要不停下腳步，總會到達終點。
今天的你，比昨天更強大。
生活不會辜負每一個努力的人，加油！
只要方向正確，就不怕路遠。
每一次努力，都是為了遇見更好的自己。
滴水穿石，不是因為力量，而是因為堅持。
今天的你，決定明天的你。
沒有天生的信心，只有不斷培養的信心。
只要路是對的，就不怕路遠。
過去屬於死神，未來屬於自己。
不要為失敗找藉口，要為成功找方法。
成功者找方法，失敗者找理由。
只有拼出來的美麗，沒有等出來的輝煌。
今天的付出，是明天的收穫。
不經歷風雨，怎麼見彩虹。
人生最大的敵人是自己，最大的失敗是自大。
與其臨淵羨魚，不如退而結網。
勤能補拙是良訓，一分耕耘一分才。
只要你不放棄，就沒有什麼能讓你退縮。
成功需要時間，但時間不會等待任何人。
昨天的太陽，曬不乾今天的衣裳。
只有不斷超越自己，才能超越別人。
沒有比腳更長的路，沒有比人更高的山。
每一次選擇，都是新的開始。
相信自己，你能做到比想像中更多。
不要讓今天的懶惰，成為明天的遺憾。
成功的人不是從不失敗，而是從不氣餒。
生活就像騎單車，要保持平衡就得往前走。
你的態度決定你的高度。
不要等待機會，而要創造機會。
只有想不到，沒有做不到。
今天的努力，是為了明天的不後悔。
成功就是把複雜的問題簡單化，然後狠狠去做。
不要因為走得太遠，而忘記為什麼出發。
只有經歷過最痛苦的堅持，才能配得上擁有最永久的幸福。
你的努力，終將成就無可替代的自己。
不要讓未來的你，討厭現在的自己。
只有拼盡全力，才能看起來毫不費力。
成功不是偶然，而是必然。
每一次挫折，都是成長的階梯。
不要害怕改變，因為改變是成長的開始。
你的堅持，會讓世界為你讓路。
只有不斷學習，才能不斷進步。
不要讓夢想只是夢想，要讓它成為現實。
今天的汗水，是明天的微笑。
只有勇敢面對，才能戰勝困難。
不要讓別人的成功，成為你的壓力。
你的努力，時間會給你答案。
只有不斷挑戰自己，才能突破極限。
不要讓過去綁架你的未來。
成功需要耐心，更需要堅持。
只有行動，才能改變現狀。
不要讓困難成為藉口，要讓它成為動力。
你的潛能，遠超你的想像。
每一次堅持，都是向成功邁進的一步。

en.text: The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
You have power over your mind — not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.
When you arise in the morning, think of what a privilege it is to be alive.
Very little is needed to make a happy life; it is all within yourself, in your way of thinking.
If it is not right, do not do it; if it is not true, do not say it.
Confine yourself to the present.
We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste much of it.
Every new beginning comes from some other beginning's end.
Difficulties strengthen the mind, as labor does the body.
He who is brave is free.
As is a tale, so is life: not how long it is, but how good it is, is what matters.
It does not matter what you bear, but how you bear it.
No man is free who is not master of himself.
It's not what happens to you, but how you react to it that matters.
Wealth consists not in having great possessions, but in having few wants.
First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
He is a wise man who does not grieve for the things which he has not, but rejoices for those which he has.
A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.
He who knows others is wise; he who knows himself is enlightened.
When I let go of what I am, I become what I might be.
The flame that burns twice as bright burns half as long — but softness overcomes hardness.
Mastering others is strength. Mastering yourself is true power.
To the mind that is still, the whole universe surrenders.
Great acts are made up of small deeds.
It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
The man who moves a mountain begins by carrying away small stones.
Our greatest glory is not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.
Wheresoever you go, go with all your heart.
The will to win, the desire to succeed — these are the keys that unlock excellence.
When it is obvious that the goals cannot be reached, adjust the action steps.
Everything has beauty, but not everyone sees it.
He who conquers himself is the mightiest warrior.
What you do not want done to yourself, do not do to others.
Opportunities multiply as they are seized.
In the midst of chaos, there is also opportunity.
What lies behind us and what lies before us are tiny matters compared to what lies within us.
Do not go where the path may lead; go instead where there is no path and leave a trail.
Write it on your heart that every day is the best day in the year.
What you do speaks so loudly that I cannot hear what you say.
Finish each day and be done with it. You have done what you could.
Once you make a decision, the universe conspires to make it happen.
The only person you are destined to become is the person you decide to be.
Nothing great was ever achieved without enthusiasm.
Go confidently in the direction of your dreams. Live the life you have imagined.
It's not what you look at that matters, it's what you see.
Success usually comes to those who are too busy to be looking for it.
What you get by achieving your goals is not as important as what you become by achieving them.
The price of anything is the amount of life you exchange for it.
Do not wait for extraordinary circumstances to do good; try to use ordinary situations.
Fall seven times, stand up eight.
A river cuts through rock not because of its power, but its persistence.
The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best time is now.
Smooth seas do not make skillful sailors.
If you want to go fast, go alone. If you want to go far, go together.
A gem cannot be polished without friction, nor a person perfected without trials.
Be not afraid of going slowly; be afraid only of standing still.
Tension is who you think you should be. Relaxation is who you are.
Dig the well before you are thirsty.
A bird does not sing because it has an answer. It sings because it has a song.
The journey is the reward.
Energy and persistence conquer all things.
Well done is better than well said.
By failing to prepare, you are preparing to fail.
Lost time is never found again.
We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
Knowing yourself is the beginning of all wisdom.
Patience is bitter, but its fruit is sweet.
The only true wisdom is in knowing you know nothing.
An unexamined life is not worth living.
